# pgsauth Provider

Short-lived authentication for PGS services using local pubg-auth or SPIRE workload identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pgsauth = { source = "pubg/pgsauth" }
  }
}

provider "pgsauth" {
  spire_socket_name = "devops"

  # Optional overrides:
  # spire_socket     = "/var/run/spire/sockets/devops.sock"
  # azuread_cli_bin_path     = "/usr/local/bin/pubg-auth"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `azuread_cli_bin_path` (String) Absolute pubg-auth executable path. Unset searches PATH. An invalid explicit path fails without SPIRE fallback.
- `spire_socket` (String) Absolute SPIRE Unix socket path. Takes precedence over spire_socket_name.
- `spire_socket_name` (String) SPIRE socket name. Resolves to /var/run/spire/sockets/<name>.sock when spire_socket is unset.
